open_points.subject: A21 security-review validity after the A01 amendment
open_points.text: A21 rule 2 says, “A change to a decision a category names reopens this review.” Its concurrency category names A01, but A01 has since changed while A21 is stated to remain closed and still says the review is complete and PERFORMED.
open_points.question: Is A21 reopened and awaiting a new accepted security review of the amended A01, or was that review re-performed so A21 may remain closed?
options: A21 is reopened and its completeness claim is not currently valid.
The amended A01 was reviewed and A21 was accepted again, but that acceptance is missing from the texts.
The A01 amendment is exempt from A21 rule 2, although no such exception is stated.
open_points.default_guess: Treat A21 as reopened until the amended A01 has been reviewed and A21 accepted again.

witness.initial: A21 is closed, names A01 under the concurrency category, and declares the security review complete and PERFORMED.
events: The owner changes A01 rules 7–8 to add ordering between creates and anonymisation or erasure and to make a post-removal reuse a new create.
A later release reviewer decides whether the unchanged A21 still authorizes proceeding.
outcomes: Following A21 rule 2, the reviewer treats the security review as reopened and does not rely on its completeness claim.
Following A21's unchanged closed status and PERFORMED declaration, the reviewer treats the security review as still complete.
witness.observer: The release or security reviewer deciding whether States 0–2 have a currently accepted security review.
